statement.p: Calculate the flux of the vector field \vec F = -8\vec i + x^{2}\vec j - 5\vec k, through the square of side 4 in the plane y=8, centered on the y-axis, with sides parallel to the x and z axes, and oriented in the positive y-direction.

static.solution: \vec j-component, and since d\vec A = \vec j dx\,dz on the square, S, we have \hbox{Flux } = \int_S(-8\vec i + x^{2}\vec j - 5\vec k)\cdot d\vec A =\int_{-2}^{2}\int_{-2}^{2} x^{2}\vec j\cdot \vec j dx\,dz =\int_{-2}^{2}\frac{x^3}3\bigg|_{-2}^2\,dz = \frac{16}{3}\cdot 4 = \frac{64}{3}.
